profileInfoDesc: Your current login credentials and system role in the store
themeDesc: Choose light, dark, or system appearance mode

mockModeNoticeDesc: Password updates are simulated in mock mode.
runningLowDesc: When stock drops to {{percent}}% or lower, it will be marked as Running Low.

demoResetDetail: All data has been restored to default seeds.
restoreDemoImagesCardDesc: Restore deterministic SVG illustrations for default demo items
restoreDemoImagesBody: This will scan for standard demo products whose packshot image is missing or empty, and restore their vector illustrations without affecting any custom photos you uploaded.
confirmRestoreDemoImagesDesc: This will assign demo vector illustrations to all matching products that currently have no photo. Any custom product photos you uploaded will NOT be changed.
